[2026-08-26T22:16:17.013Z] [world] You crouch for the blade — the Hollow Edge, the black mark of the Forgotten Order's enforcers, its steel weeping a faint corruption that fogs the air. But the grip is wrong. It's honed: razored along the inner curve so the handle itself is a second blade, and only one of its edges is meant for the enemy. Take it up untrained and you flay your own palm to the bone. Only a hand that knows the Order's hold — that two-finger grip they teach behind sealed doors — can carry it. You leave it where it fell.
